briefNote: Saturday crawl: news gathered via web search (feeds and CoinCarp could not be fetched today); token-sale lists, ETF data and weekly sections carried over.
brief: **BTC & sentiment:** bitcoin bounced toward ~$61.5K after Thanksgiving, then slipped back under $60K on Friday even as Wall Street rallied; a ~$7B month-end options expiry has rolled off. The Fear & Greed index sits around 10, deep in extreme fear, and ETH is trading below $1,650.

**ETFs:** US markets were shut on 26 Nov; the last reported spot ETH day was a $68.5M outflow on 25 Nov (ninth straight), with net assets near $8.9B. Spot BTC funds have lost roughly $5.4B in November, their worst month on record, and spot SOL funds saw a small $0.9M outflow on 27 Nov.

**Macro:** a quiet weekend. Next week brings China PMIs (30 Nov), Eurozone flash HICP and US ISM manufacturing/JOLTS (1 Dec), ISM services (3 Dec) and the November jobs report on 4 Dec, ahead of the 8–9 Dec FOMC.
**Hyperliquid:** HYPE rebounded after Franklin Templeton said it will add the token to a crypto ETF in December; a supply update shows ~49M HYPE burned so far.
**Liquidity watch:** CryptoQuant says a lasting BTC recovery needs USDT supply to start growing again; ~12K ETH tied to this year's Binance hack moved on-chain.
**Policy:** Fidelity filed for a spot LINK ETF, ESMA plans to overhaul the EU MiCA register by 2027, and Injective is lobbying the SEC to allow on-chain order books for tokenized stocks.
**Unlocks (next 3 days):** Falcon Finance releases ~$21M of FF (~6% of circulating) on 29 Nov, then Sui's monthly ~$8M unlock lands on 1 Dec.
